Jeu de tir de bulles : vise à la souris: A bubble shooter: aim with the mouse (the dotted line shows the bounces), shoot, and group at least three bubbles of the same colour to pop them; everything no longer attached to the ceiling falls and scores big. The ceiling drops every 7 shots, X swaps the bubble with the next one, and each cleared board brings a new one with an extra colour.
Le pointillé montre la trajectoire, rebo: The dotted line shows the trajectory, including bounces on the edges.
Souris : viser · clic : tirer · X : écha: Mouse: aim · click: shoot · X: swap the bubble
Tous les 7 tirs, le plafond descend d'un: Every 7 shots, the ceiling goes down one row. Bring down whole clusters to score big.
